comment: cmd.c doterrain() 1153-1164 preselects 'known map without monsters, objects, and traps' and shows the known map for n == 0 as well as for the preselected row. A Valkyrie in normal play dismisses the welcome line's --More-- with a space and opens #terrain. Segment 1 presses 'a', the preselected row's own selector, which toggles it off and ends the PICK_ONE menu (n == 0). Segment 2 searches with ':' for 'and traps', which only the preselected row matches, with the same result. Segment 3 types '2a': wintty.c toggle_menu_curr() gives a selected row a pending count instead of toggling it off, so n == 1. Each then leaves the terrain view. Seeds, clocks, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
